title: Authenticated access to protected assurance functions
objective: Prevent unauthenticated access to assurance data and actions
test_procedure: Attempt protected access without a valid authenticated session

title: Organization tenant isolation
test_procedure: Attempt read/write operations against another organization using an authenticated principal

title: Evidence integrity and provenance
objective: Ensure evidence used in testing is attributable and unaltered
test_procedure: Verify uploader, acquisition metadata, storage identity and SHA-256 digest

title: AI-assisted conclusions remain human reviewed
test_procedure: Verify AI output has provenance and cannot transition directly to approved sign-off
